-- Private structural helpers for the Rust actor host. Instance state and command
-- execution live in actors.rs. Capture primitives before authored scripts run.
local pairs, next, rawget = pairs, next, rawget
local tonumber, tostring, type = tonumber, tostring, type
local setmetatable, getmetatable, ipairs, error = setmetatable, getmetatable, ipairs, error
local globals, getinfo, sub, match = _G, debug.getinfo, string.sub, string.match

return function(methods)
    Actor = methods.Actor
function Actor:LyricCommand(side)
	self:settext( Var "LyricText" )
	self:draworder(102)

	self:stoptweening()
	self:shadowlengthx(0)
	self:shadowlengthy(5)
	self:strokecolor(color("#000000"))

	local Zoom = SCREEN_WIDTH / (self:GetZoomedWidth()+1)
	if( Zoom > 1 ) then
		Zoom = 1
	end
	self:zoomx( Zoom )

	local lyricColor = Var "LyricColor"
	local Factor = 1
	if side == "Back" then
		Factor = 0.5
	elseif side == "Front" then
		Factor = 0.9
	end
	self:diffuse( {
		lyricColor[1] * Factor,
		lyricColor[2] * Factor,
		lyricColor[3] * Factor,
		lyricColor[4] * Factor } )

	if side == "Front" then
		self:cropright(1)
	else
		self:cropleft(0)
	end

	self:diffusealpha(0)
	self:linear(0.2)
	self:diffusealpha(0.75)
	self:linear( Var "LyricDuration" * 0.75)
	if side == "Front" then
		self:cropright(0)
	else
		self:cropleft(1)
	end
	self:sleep( Var "LyricDuration" * 0.25 )
	self:linear(0.2)
	self:diffusealpha(0)
	return self
end
    ActorFrame = setmetatable(methods.ActorFrame, {__index=Actor})
    ActorFrameTexture = setmetatable(methods.ActorFrameTexture, {__index=ActorFrame})
    BitmapText = setmetatable(methods.BitmapText, {__index=Actor})
    function BitmapText:PixelFont() self:SetTextureFiltering(false); return self end
    function BitmapText:Stroke(c) self:strokecolor(c); return self end
    function BitmapText:NoStroke() self:strokecolor(color("0,0,0,0")); return self end
    function BitmapText:settextf(...) self:settext(string.format(...)); return self end
    function BitmapText:DiffuseAndStroke(diffuseC,strokeC) self:diffuse(diffuseC); self:strokecolor(strokeC); return self end
    Sprite = setmetatable(methods.Sprite, {__index=Actor})
    Sprite.cropto = methods.CropToHelper
    Banner = setmetatable(methods.Banner, {__index=Sprite})
    ActorMultiVertex = setmetatable(methods.ActorMultiVertex, {__index=Actor})
    local function proxy_method(name)
        return function(actor, ...)
            if type(actor)~='table' then error('actor method '..name..' requires an actor') end
            local bound=rawget(actor,'__songlua_bound_methods')
            if bound~=nil and type(bound)~='table' then error('actor method table expected') end
            local method=rawget(bound or actor,name)
            if type(method)~='function' then error('native actor method '..name..' has no semantic implementation') end
            return method(actor, ...)
        end
    end
    -- The current-background Lua helper is stored on each actor. The native
    -- public forwarders still consult the private bound table, including
    -- authored replacements and the existing missing-implementation error.
    Sprite.LoadFromSongBanner = proxy_method('LoadFromSongBanner')
    Sprite.LoadFromCurrentSongBackground = proxy_method('LoadFromCurrentSongBackground')
    ActorProxy = setmetatable({SetTarget=proxy_method('SetTarget'), GetTarget=proxy_method('GetTarget')}, {__index=Actor})
    NoteField=setmetatable({}, {__index=ActorFrame})
    for _,name in ipairs{'set_step_callback','set_set_pressed_callback',
        'set_did_tap_note_callback','set_did_hold_note_callback','step','set_pressed',
        'did_tap_note','did_hold_note','get_column_actors','GetBeatBars','SetBeatBars','SetBeatBarsAlpha'} do
        NoteField[name]=proxy_method(name)
    end
    local text_displays = {RollingNumbers=true, BPMDisplay=true, DeviceList=true, InputList=true}
    local private_frames = {StepsDisplay=true,PercentageDisplay=true,HoldJudgment=true,NoteField=true,PlayerActor=true,CourseContentsList=true,GraphDisplay=true, SongMeterDisplay=true}
    local private_actors = {Timer=true,NoteColumnRenderer=true,LifeMeter=true,Model=true,GraphDisplayBody=true, GraphDisplayLine=true}
    local classes = {StepsDisplay=ActorFrame,PercentageDisplay=ActorFrame,Timer=Actor,HoldJudgment=ActorFrame,NoteField=NoteField,NoteColumnRenderer=Actor,PlayerActor=ActorFrame,LifeMeter=Actor,Model=Actor,CourseContentsList=ActorFrame,GraphDisplay=ActorFrame, SongMeterDisplay=ActorFrame, GraphDisplayBody=Actor, GraphDisplayLine=Actor, Banner=Banner,RollingNumbers=Actor, BPMDisplay=Actor, DeviceList=Actor, InputList=Actor, BitmapText=BitmapText, Actor=Actor, ActorFrame=ActorFrame, ActorFrameTexture=ActorFrameTexture, Quad=Sprite, Sprite=Sprite, ActorMultiVertex=ActorMultiVertex, ActorProxy=ActorProxy, WrapperState=ActorFrame, Sound=Actor}
    local lookups = {}
    for name, class in pairs(classes) do
        local public_name = name=='NoteField' and 'NoteField' or name == 'Quad' and 'Sprite' or (name == 'WrapperState' or private_frames[name]) and 'ActorFrame' or (name == 'Sound' or text_displays[name] or private_actors[name]) and 'Actor' or name
        lookups[name] = function(actor, key)
            if type(key) ~= 'string' then return nil end
            local current = globals[public_name]
            if current == nil then current=class end
            if type(current) ~= 'table' then error('actor class table expected') end
            local value=current[key]
            if value~=nil or (name~='Sound' and not text_displays[name] and not private_frames[name] and not private_actors[name]) then return value end
            local bound=rawget(actor,'__songlua_bound_methods')
            if bound~=nil and type(bound)~='table' then error('actor method table expected') end
            return bound and bound[key]
        end
    end
    local function copy_text_state(value)
        if type(value) ~= 'table' then return value end
        local result = {}
        for key, item in next, value do result[copy_text_state(key)] = copy_text_state(item) end
        return result
    end
    local current_background = methods.CurrentSongBackground
    local clone_template = methods.CloneTemplate
    local function concat_template(left, right)
        if type(right) ~= 'table' then error('actor declaration table expected') end
        local actor = clone_template(left)
        for key, value in next, right do
            if key ~= '__songlua_actor_type' and key ~= '__songlua_script_dir'
                and key ~= '__songlua_song_dir' and key ~= '__songlua_bound_methods' then
                local previous = rawget(actor, key)
                if type(previous) == 'function' and type(value) == 'function' then
                    local first, second = previous, value
                    value = function(...) first(...); return second(...) end
                end
                actor[key] = value
            end
        end
        return setmetatable(actor, getmetatable(left))
    end
    local function create(class, parent, attrs, template, inplace)
        local actor = inplace and attrs or {}
        for key, value in next, attrs do
            if not inplace and type(key)=='string' and key~='children' and key~='__songlua_bound_methods'
                and not (template and (key=='__songlua_def_owned' or key=='__songlua_parent'
                    or key=='__songlua_load_name' or key=='__songlua_native_name'
                    or key=='__songlua_init_commands_ran' or key=='__songlua_startup_commands_ran'
                    or key=='__songlua_startup_command_started')) then
                if template and (class=='BitmapText' or text_displays[class]) and (key=='__songlua_text_attributes'
                    or key=='__songlua_stroke_color' or key=='Text' or sub(key,1,16)=='__songlua_state_'
                    or sub(key,1,18)=='__songlua_capture_') then
                    value=copy_text_state(value)
                end
                actor[key]=value
            end
        end
        actor.LoadFromCurrentSongBackground=current_background()
        actor.__songlua_actor_type=class
        if not inplace and attrs._Dir ~= nil then actor.__songlua_script_dir = attrs._Dir end
        return setmetatable(actor, {__index=lookups[class], __concat=concat_template})
    end
    -- Snapshot the complete XNode-shaped input before running any Init callback.
    -- Array entries precede next traversal; the native duplicate range counts
    -- table entries, not array slots. Ancestors are skipped, shared siblings copied.
    local function snapshot(source, active)
        local attrs, entries, nodes = {}, {}, {}
        local i = 1
        while rawget(source, i) ~= nil do
            local value = rawget(source, i)
            if type(value) == 'table' then entries[#entries+1] = {tostring(i), value} end
            i = i + 1
        end
        local prefix = #entries
        for key, value in next, source do
            if type(key) ~= 'string' and type(key) ~= 'number' then
                error('actor declaration keys must be strings or numbers')
            end
            if type(key)=='string' and key~='children' then attrs[key]=value end
            if type(value) == 'table' then
                local index = tonumber(key)
                if not (index and index >= 1 and index <= prefix and index % 1 == 0) then
                    entries[#entries+1] = {tostring(key), value}
                end
            else
                attrs[tostring(key)] = value
            end
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
            local key, value = entry[1], entry[2]
            if not active[value] then
                active[value] = true
                nodes[#nodes+1] = {key, snapshot(value, active)}
                active[value] = nil
            end
        end
        return {attrs, nodes, source}
    end
    local function group(actors)
        return setmetatable(actors, {__songlua_child_group=true, __index=function(t, key)
            if tonumber(key) then return rawget(t, key) end
            -- Production resolves the last child's instance member at lookup,
            -- then resolves it again at invocation and forwards every result.
            local actor = rawget(t, #t)
            if not actor then return nil end
            local member = actor[key]
            if type(member)~='function' then return member end
            return function(self, ...)
                local last=self[#self]
                return last[key](last, ...)
            end
        end})
    end
    local function raw_children(actor)
        local source=rawget(actor,'children')
        local array_only=type(source)~='table'
        if array_only then source=actor end
        local entries={}
        local i=1
        while rawget(source,i)~=nil do
            local child=rawget(source,i)
            if type(child)=='table' then entries[#entries+1]={i,child} end
            i=i+1
        end
        local prefix=#entries
        for key,child in next,source do
            if type(child)=='table' then
                local kind=type(key)
                local n=(kind=='number' or kind=='string') and tonumber(key)
                if not(n and n>=1 and n<=prefix and n%1==0) then entries[#entries+1]={key,child} end
            end
        end
        local selected={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
            local key,child=entry[1],entry[2]
            if not array_only or ((type(key)=='number' or type(key)=='string') and match(tostring(key),'^%d+$')) then
                if rawget(child,'Condition')~=false then selected[#selected+1]=child end
            end
        end
        return selected
    end
    local function offline_children(actor)
        local source=rawget(actor,'children')
        local array_only=type(source)~='table'
        if array_only then source=actor end
        local entries={}
        local i=1
        while rawget(source,i)~=nil do
            local child=rawget(source,i)
            if type(child)=='table' then entries[#entries+1]={i,child} end
            i=i+1
        end
        local prefix=#entries
        for key,child in next,source do
            if type(child)=='table' then
                local kind=type(key)
                local n=(kind=='number' or kind=='string') and tonumber(key)
                if not(n and n>=1 and n<=prefix and n%1==0) then entries[#entries+1]={key,child} end
            end
        end
        local selected={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
            local key=entry[1]
            if not array_only or ((type(key)=='number' or type(key)=='string') and match(tostring(key),'^%d+$')) then
                selected[#selected+1]=entry
            end
        end
        return source,selected
    end
    return create, function(source) return snapshot(source, {}) end, group,
        function(callback)
            local info = getinfo(callback, 'S')
            return info and sub(info.source, 1, 7) == '@theme:'
        end, globals, tonumber, function(t)
            local entries={}
            for key,value in next,t do entries[#entries+1]={key,value} end
            return entries
        end, setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}), setmetatable, raw_children, offline_children
end

-- Adapted from ITGmania v1.2.0, revision 5c737928d93778c2c9f68e276052b220b43a468f.
-- Original: Themes/_fallback/Scripts/02 ActorDef.lua.
-- Path separator/absolute-drive handling and DeadSync's existing virtual theme
-- actors are adapted here. Remaining decoration helpers have pending bindings.
-- See docs/testing/2026-11-04-rust-lua-actor-definitions.md for provenance.
local theme_path_actor_type = __songlua_theme_path_actor_type
local rawset = rawset

-- Convert "@/path/file" to "/path/".
local function DebugPathToRealPath( p )
	if not p or p:sub( 1, 1 ) ~= "@" then
		return nil
	end

	local Path = p:sub( 2 )
	local pos = Path:match("^.*()[/\\]") or 0
	return string.sub( Path, 1, pos )
end

local function MergeTables( left, right )
	local ret = { }
	for key, val in pairs(left) do
		ret[key] = val
	end

	for key, val in pairs(right) do
		if ret[key] then
			if type(val) == "function" and
			   type(ret[key]) == "function" then
				local f1 = ret[key]
				local f2 = val
				val = function(...)
					f1(...)
					return f2(...)
				end
			else
				Warn( string.format( "%s\n\nOverriding \"%s\": %s with %s",
					 debug.traceback(), key, type(ret[key]), type(val)) )
			end
		end

		ret[key] = val
	end
	setmetatable( ret, getmetatable(left) )
	return ret
end

DefMetatable = {
	__concat = function(left, right)
		return MergeTables( left, right )
	end
}

-- This is used as follows:
--
--   t = Def.Class { table }
Def = {}
setmetatable( Def, {
	__index = function(self, Class)
		-- t is an actor definition table.  name is the type
		-- given to Def.  Fill in standard fields.
		return function(t)
			if not ActorUtil.IsRegisteredClass(Class) then
				error( Class .. " is not a registered actor class", 2 )
			end

			t.Class = Class
			-- Explicit Def construction initializes resources again, even when
			-- given a declaration returned by the virtual theme loader.
			rawset(t, "__songlua_theme_path_actor", nil)

			local level = 2
			if t._Level then
				level = t._Level + 1
			end
			local info

			-- Sometimes info.source will be "=(tail call)" when we need the actual
			-- file something came from.
			-- So this loop climbs the stack until it reaches an actual file path
			-- or reaches end.
			repeat
				info = debug.getinfo(level,"Sl");
				if info then
					-- Source file of caller:
					local source= info.source
					t._Source= source
					-- Line number of caller:
					t._Line = info.currentline
					t._Dir= DebugPathToRealPath(source)

					-- level is incremented for the next time through the loop.  Take
					-- that into account if level is used after the loop.
					level= level + 1
				end
			until t._Dir or not info

			setmetatable( t, DefMetatable )
			return t
		end
	end,
})

function ResolveRelativePath(path, level, optional)
	if path:sub(1,1) ~= "/" and not path:match("^%a:[/\\]") and path:sub(1,2) ~= "\\\\" then
		-- "Working directory":
		local sDir = DebugPathToRealPath( debug.getinfo(level+1,"S").source )
		assert( sDir )

		path = sDir .. path
	end

	path = ActorUtil.ResolvePath(path, level+1, optional)
	return path
end

-- Load an actor template.
function LoadActorFunc( path, level )
	level = level or 1

	-- Virtual theme resources use the production host's media classification;
	-- they do not resolve relative to the caller or require a filesystem entry.
	local themeClass = theme_path_actor_type(path)
	if themeClass then
		return function()
			local actor = { _Level = level+1 }
			if themeClass == "Sound" then actor.File = path end
			if themeClass == "Sprite" then actor.Texture = path end
			actor = Def[themeClass](actor)
			actor.__songlua_theme_path_actor = true
			return actor
		end
	end

	if path == "" then
		error( "Passing in a blank filename is a great way to eat up RAM. Good thing we warn you about this." )
	end

	local ResolvedPath = ResolveRelativePath( path, level+1 )
	if not ResolvedPath then
		error( path .. ": not found", level+1 )
	end
	path = ResolvedPath

	local Type = ActorUtil.GetFileType( path )
	Trace( "Loading " .. path .. ", type " .. tostring(Type) )

	if Type == "FileType_Lua" then
		-- Load the file.
		local chunk, errmsg = loadfile( path )
		if not chunk then error(errmsg) end
		return chunk
	end

	if Type == "FileType_Bitmap" or Type == "FileType_Movie" then
		return function()
			return Def.Sprite {
				_Level = level+1,
				Texture = path
			}
		end
	elseif Type == "FileType_Sound" then
		return function()
			return Def.Sound {
				_Level = level+1,
				File = path
			}
		end
	elseif Type == "FileType_Model" then
		return function()
			return Def.Model {
				_Level = level+1,
				Meshes = path,
				Materials = path,
				Bones = path
			}
		end
	elseif Type == "FileType_Directory" then
		return function()
			return Def.BGAnimation {
				_Level = level+1,
				AniDir = path
			}
		end
	end

	error( path .. ": unknown file type (" .. tostring(Type) .. ")", level+1 )
end

-- Load and create an actor template.
function LoadActor( path, ... )
	local t = LoadActorFunc( path, 2 )
	assert(t)
	return t(...)
end

function WrapInActorFrame( t )
	return Def.ActorFrame { children = t }
end

NullActor = { Class="Actor", _Source="(null actor)" }
